quarterly_data.quarter: Dell press release: Dell Technologies Drives the Agentic AI Era with New (10-07-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Dell introduced the XPS 16 Creator Edition, which Dell calls the first XPS laptop powered by NVIDIA RTX Spark: the superchip combines up to a 6,144-core NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU, up to a 20-core NVIDIA Grace CPU and up to 128GB of unified memory in a 17.8mm chassis. It will be available in the U.S. for pre-order from Best Buy on October 7 and on Dell.com soon after. The Dell Creator Edition Desktop with the same RTX Spark superchip (up to 1 petaflop of FP4, AI models up to 200 billion parameters) and Dell Pro Precision with GB300 on Windows are 'coming soon' (no date given).
quarterly_data.figure: up to 6,144-core Blackwell RTX GPU, up to 20-core Grace CPU, up to 128GB unified memory; U.S. pre-order from Best Buy on October 7
